summary: Independent read-only review found the terminal rematch implementation consistent with the accepted contract on synthetic evidence.
accepted: ZIP membership, district mass, and geometry remain fixed during rematching.
Centered and uncentered welfare metrics are distinct.
Terminal reservation recomputation uses realized ZIP aggregates and does not reuse a state-grain vector.
Reruns preserve the original level-0 assignment and output ownership is consistent.
validation: 11 FEFx, 31 stage2-state, and 70 full-plan focused tests passed in prior task evidence.
Full runner evidence: 863 passed and 9 failures, all missing-ZCTA export failures.
pytest is unavailable in the frozen virtualenv.
blockers: The confidential CONUS instance, geo cache, and 2025 ZCTA shapefile are absent, so no real-data run was possible.
followups: Run the real CONUS benchmark when its data dependencies are restored.
missing_context: Serena tools were unavailable; the audit used rtk searches and line-range reads.
